resources.string:
Your phone creates an encrypted connection to the SealGate gateway. Nothing on the internet can connect directly to your phone.

Technical details
The app uses one outbound secure WebSocket (WSS) and does not open an inbound port.
Local tools: Device information, Battery, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and USB
Use a wss:// URL (ws:// is allowed for local development)
Paste your API key from the dashboard
